Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 훈련이 싫어 칭얼거리고 있다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?

Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se plaint et gémit qu'elle ne veut plus s'entraîner. Que devrais-je dire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> jammert und beschwert sich, dass sie nicht mehr trainieren will. Was soll ich sagen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se está quejando de que no quiere entrenar. ¿Qué debería decir?

Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> กำลังบ่นว่าไม่อยากฝึกแล้ว จะพูดว่าอะไรดีนะ?

Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> प्रशिक्षण नहीं करना चाहता और शिकायत कर रहा है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Then how about we take a break for today?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: じゃあ今日はここまで休もうか？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Alors, on va s'arrêter là aujourd'hui ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: วันนี้ก็ถึงเวลาพักแล้วเหรอ?
ฉันเห็นอยู่แล้ว

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Here. Drink this and perk up.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: これを飲んで元気を出そう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tiens. Bois ça et reprends des forces.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Hier. Trink das und muntere dich auf.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Beba isso e recupere suas forças.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: นี่ ดื่มนี่แล้วร่าเริงขึ้นหน่อยสิ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đây. Uống cái này vào cho tỉnh táo.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: लो। इसे पियो और जोश में आओ।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。

Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió dejar de entrenar y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã quyết định dừng tập luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschlossen hatte, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún parecía insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจ

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, nhưng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.

Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.

Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
